notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627460/d41870839b848de30978c9378840f953100e8c84.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hello everyone! Introducing the latest girl from our new game – Farah Almari[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Farah is a young and talented weaver and clothing designer born in a small town in the south of the kingdom. Her family has been involved in textile production for several generations, and she grew up among woolen fabrics, embroideries, and various materials.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Since childhood, Farah has shown a special interest in fashion and creating unique things. She was one of the few girls of her time who dared to learn from masters in creating armor and protective clothing. At the age of 18, she went on a journey to different cities to study different styles and techniques for creating clothing and armor.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]In the city of Ignacia, Farah opened her own store called "Silk Dome", where she sold both casual clothes and special protective armor for heroes and warriors. Her products were not only of high quality, but also of elegant design, which made her shop one of the most popular places in the city.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Here you can take a closer look at our beautiful weaver![/h3][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627460/c7f735b45484dea4215c4484560854629ae9319c.png"][/img][u]Also, don't forget to add our upcoming games to your wishlist:[/u][/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576130/CYBER_RONIN_Lust/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576110/Memories_with_You/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: DEVLOG #3
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627460/3f0586cc0009579238d6a7744e742ba835121d98.png"][/img][/p][h2][/h2][h2]Hello everyone! It's time to meet another beautiful girl from our game - Karina Vellar[/h2][p][/p][h3]Karina Vellar is a half-goblin, half-human, born in the small border town of Ignasia. Her father was a human from a family of merchants, and her mother was a goblin from a tribe of forest hunters.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Karina grew up in a poor family, where she had to help her parents from an early age. Her mother taught her the art of survival in the forest, and her father passed on knowledge of trade and exchange of goods. Having reached adulthood, she decided to start her own business to provide herself with a decent life. Karina opened a small grocery store in Ignasia, which specializes in selling fresh food, herbal infusions, elixirs and other useful goods. Over time, it turned into a successful trading house and became a meeting place for all residents of the city, where they could not only buy necessary things, but also get good advice or just chat.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Karina is an energetic and purposeful girl. She is never afraid of difficulties and is always ready to help others, especially if they find themselves in a difficult situation. However, her pride and independence sometimes prevent her from asking for help, even when she really needs it. She values ​​honesty and fairness, so her goods are always high-quality, and the prices are reasonable.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]We suggest taking a closer look at our charming girl![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627460/222e1f56083151193c14550a0d3186280d7c3cf3.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576330/Hentai_Tavern/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576110/Memories_with_You/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627460/42bf1ec93f45b9413db481d625c5278685c5cb26.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello everyone! We continue introducing you to our beautiful girls 😍[/b][/h1]

Today we have Emilia Cullen, a holy sister who runs the Temple of the Goddess of Mercy in the city of Ignacia. She is the spiritual leader of the temple and will help the player level up their character through prayers, rituals, and special blessings ✨

The sister was born in a small village on the outskirts of the kingdom, where her family was known for their devotion to religion. Since childhood, she showed special piety and a desire to serve people. At the age of 16, she decided to become a holy sister and went to the city of Ignacia to continue her studies at the Temple of the Goddess of Mercy. After several years of service in the temple, Emilia became its abbess and began to help heroes and travelers, using her knowledge to level up their abilities and protect them from evil 💒

Emilia has a quiet but determined nature. She is always ready to help those who need support - both spiritual and physical. Her appearance and behavior combine severity and gentleness. Although her appearance may seem modest, she has inner strength and faith that inspire others. Her eyes, one of which is an unusual red color, often cause surprise, but this only adds to her mystery 👀

[h1][b]We suggest taking a look at the parameters of our sister 🥰[/b][/h1]

notes.title: DEVLOG #1
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello everyone! Today, we’d like to introduce you to one of the characters from our upcoming game 😉[/h1][/b]

Today we introduce you to Cecilia Whiteheart — dark elf who works as a waitress in the "Red Dragon" tavern in the city of Ignasia. She’s known for her mystery and taciturnity which makes her past even more interesting 👀

Almost nothing is known about Cecilia's origin. Nobody knows where did she come from or how old she is but everyone’s guessing that there’s some kind of secret connection between her and the former owner of the tavern 🏠

Cecilia is a charismatic and curvy girl whose attractiveness goes well with her cold and slightly aloof behavior. She rarely talks about herself and prefers to keep her personal life in secret. Yet her professionalism and attentiveness make her one of the most popular waitresses in the tavern. Her appearance and demeanor make people respect and even lowkey admire her, although some of them think her way too cold and unapproachable 🥶

[b][h1]Here you can take a closer look at our elf 😍[/h1][/b]
